MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #2
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 48
   C. 156
   D. 24

2. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 9 cm³
   B. 18 cm³
   C. 27 cm³
   D. 12 cm³

3. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 169
   C. 26
   D. 170

4. Solve for x: x + 9 = 20. (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 12
   C. 9
   D. 20

5. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 14
   C. 50
   D. 7

6. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 40 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 43
   C. 31
   D. 41

7. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 25
   C. 10
   D. 5

8. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 4
   D. 400

9. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 0
   C. 17
   D. 16

10. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 9
   C. 82
   D. 81

11. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 4
   C. 40
   D. 400

12. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 42
   C. 12
   D. 24

13. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x = 5
   B. x < 5
   C. x ≥ 0 only
   D. x > 5

14. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 10
   C. 400
   D. 4

15. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 5
   C. 37
   D. 36

16. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 4

17. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 72
   B. 73
   C. 17
   D. 1

18. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 2
   C. 25
   D. 24

19. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 11
   C. 5
   D. 24

20. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 81
   C. 18
   D. 90

21. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 1000 m²
   B. 10 000 m²
   C. 100 000 m²
   D. 100 m²

22. Solve for x: x + 6 = 15. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 9
   C. 10
   D. 6

23. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 7 cm and 24 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 17
   C. 27
   D. 25

24. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 48
   C. 14
   D. 2

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
